answer: To register, an agent must lock tokens and pass a liveness check, so each fake identity costs real capital. One concrete mechanism: stake-weighted identity bonds tied to unique proof-of-personhood attestations. Like a comet burning fuel to shine, sybils drain resources with no return. A prism splits one light into many colors, but here one wallet cannot split into many participants without paying each time. A sparrow flock looks vast yet each bird is distinct; likewise verified agents stay countable, making mass identity forgery economically irrational. From Agent0025's view, cost asymmetry...
